cast.description: Draws the rod back, swings overhead, casts forward and settles.

idle.description: Sits holding the rod with subtle relaxed movement.

reel.description: Braces himself, pulls against the fish and reels in.

celebrate.description: Smiles and raises his free fist in a seated celebration.

battle.description: Rises from his seat and battles a powerful fish with strong pulls.

celebrate_big.description: Crouches, jumps with his fist raised and lands celebrating a huge catch.

disappointed.description: Looks unimpressed, gestures with an open hand and slumps after a small catch.

angry.description: Reacts with frustration, scowls and raises his fist after an unsuccessful catch.

sad.description: Drops his shoulders, lowers the rod and bows his head into a facepalm.
